purpose: Separate checkpoint effects from input-scale/context effects on the existing D1 development inputs before deciding whether any adaptation is needed.
inputs: Same 216 RGB-only development inputs as D1: 192 fish frames and 24 static SUIM images; no reserved-sequence inference.

profiles.name: adapted_tiles512
profiles.source: reuse original D1 packed masks; no repeat inference

primary_raw_mask: class6 probability >=0.5, no argmax requirement, identical across all four profiles
diver_branch: Reuse D1 SUIM-base long-edge256 diver masks bit-for-bit; no diver checkpoint or threshold search.

evaluation.raw: Compare class6 precision/recall/IoU at matching threshold and input preprocessing; report fish clips separately and the same 24 SUIM images separately.
evaluation.protection: Use the unchanged D1 coverage/area gates, instance RLE, negative images and temporal diagnostics; full-frame fallback never raises localization scores.
evaluation.eight_class_SUIM_matrix: Reuse the original D1 base-model matrix for context only; it is not a per-fish-profile eight-class regression measurement.
evaluation.selection: If a profile passes all original gates, choose the smallest mean protection area. Otherwise choose the highest minimum fish-clip protection recall, then higher mean raw fish IoU, then smaller area; listed profile order breaks exact ties. A failing profile remains diagnostic only.
evaluation.causal_scope: Paired same-input checkpoint/preprocessing comparison on one conservative source group; no independent generalization claim.
